' err' : kind === 'stale' ? ' stale' : ''); } function fmtTime(d) { return d.toLocaleString(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'medium', timeZone: 'America/Denver' }); } // -- Parsing -------------------------------------------------------------- function parseXml(text) { // The export file is missing its XML declaration and opening / // tags, and the first is chopped to "t id=...". partyEl.getAttribute('prtId') : '', votes: 0, }; contest.choices.push(choice); choiceIndex[choice.id] = choice; } contests.push(contest); } // Aggregate votes from every ; also mark locations as reported. let ballots = 0, voters = 0, resultGroups = 0; for (const rg of doc.querySelectorAll('results resultgroup')) { resultGroups++; ballots += parseInt(rg.getAttribute('bal') || '0', 10); voters += parseInt(rg.getAttribute('vtrs') || '0', 10); const vl = vlById.get(rg.getAttribute('vlId')); if (vl) vl.reported = true; for (const v of rg.querySelectorAll('vot')) { const chId = v.getAttribute('chId'); const n = parseInt(v.getAttribute('vot') || '0', 10); const target = choiceIndex[chId]; if (target) target.votes += n; } } contests.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order); votingLocations.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)); return { contests, ballots, voters, resultGroups, votingLocations }; } // -- Rendering ------------------------------------------------------------ function render() { const { contests, ballots, votingLocations } = state.data || { contests: [], ballots: 0, votingLocations: [] }; $('stat-ballots').textContent = ballots.toLocaleString(); $('stat-contests').textContent = contests.length.toLocaleString(); renderReporting(votingLocations); const q = state.filter.trim().toLowerCase(); const filtered = q ? contests.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (c.districtName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)) : contests; const grid = $('grid'); grid.innerHTML = ''; for (const c of filtered) grid.appendChild(renderContest(c)); $('empty').hidden = filtered.length !== 0; } function renderReporting(locations) { const panel = $('reporting'); if (!locations || locations.length === 0) { panel.hidden = true; return; } panel.hidden = false; // Counted = all non-spare locations (spares are excluded entirely per // Clerk request, even when activated). const counted = locations.filter(v => !v.isSpare); const total = counted.length; const reported = counted.filter(v => v.reported).length; const pct = total ? (100 * reported / total) : 0; $('vl-reported').textContent = reported.toLocaleString(); $('vl-total').textContent = total.toLocaleString(); $('vl-pct').textContent = `· ${pct.toFixed(1)}%`; $('vl-bar').style.width = pct + '%'; // Outstanding first, then reported; alphabetical within each group. const outstanding = counted.filter(v => !v.reported) .slice().sort((a,b) => a.displayName.localeCompare(b.displayName)); const done = counted.filter(v => v.reported) .slice().sort((a,b) => a.displayName.localeCompare(b.displayName)); const grid = $('loc-grid'); grid.innerHTML = ''; if (outstanding.length) { grid.appendChild(divider(`Outstanding (${outstanding.length})`)); for (const v of outstanding) grid.appendChild(locChip(v, false)); } if (done.length) { grid.appendChild(divider(`Reported (${done.length})`)); for (const v of done) grid.appendChild(locChip(v, true)); } } function divider(label) { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'loc-divider'; d.textContent = label; return d; } function locChip(v, isReported) { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'loc ' + (isReported ? 'reported' : 'outstanding'); el.title = v.displayName + (isReported ? ' — reported' : ' — not yet reported'); const icon = document.createElement('span'); icon.className = 'icon'; icon.textContent = isReported ? '✓' : '·'; const name = document.createElement('span'); name.className = 'name'; name.textContent = v.displayName; el.appendChild(icon); el.appendChild(name); return el; } function renderContest(c) { const card = document.createElement('section'); card.className = 'contest'; const total = c.choices.reduce((s, ch) => s + ch.votes, 0); const sorted = c.choices.slice().sort((a, b) => b.votes - a.votes || a.order - b.order); const winnersByVotes = new Set(sorted.slice(0, c.pos).filter(ch => ch.votes > 0).map(ch => ch.id)); const h = document.createElement('h2'); h.textContent = c.name; card.appendChild(h); const meta = document.createElement('div'); meta.className = 'meta'; const pieces = []; if (c.districtName) pieces.push(c.districtName); if (c.pos > 1) pieces.push(`Elect ${c.pos}`); pieces.push(`${total.toLocaleString()} votes`); meta.textContent = pieces.join(' · '); card.appendChild(meta); for (const ch of sorted) { const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'choice'; const name = document.createElement('div'); name.className = 'name'; if (ch.party) { const tag = document.createElement('span'); tag.className = 'party'; tag.textContent = ch.party; tag.style.background = PARTY_COLORS[ch.party] || '#6b7280'; name.appendChild(tag); } name.appendChild(document.createTextNode(ch.name)); if (winnersByVotes.has(ch.id)) { const w = document.createElement('span'); w.className = 'winner-mark'; w.textContent = '✓ leading'; name.appendChild(w); } row.appendChild(name); const nums = document.createElement('div'); nums.className = 'nums'; const pct = total ? (100 * ch.votes / total) : 0; nums.innerHTML = `${ch.votes.toLocaleString()} · ${pct.toFixed(1)}%`; row.appendChild(nums); const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'bar'; const fill = document.createElement('span'); fill.style.width = (total ? pct : 0) + '%'; fill.style.background = PARTY_COLORS[ch.party] || '#374151'; bar.appendChild(fill); row.appendChild(bar); card.appendChild(row); } return card; } // -- Wire up -------------------------------------------------------------- $('refresh').addEventListener('click', () => checkAndLoad({ force: true })); $('filter').addEventListener('input', (e) => { state.filter = e.target.value; render(); }); $('reporting').addEventListener('toggle', (e) => { $('toggle-hint').textContent = e.target.open ? 'click to collapse' : 'click to expand'; }); checkAndLoad({ force: true }); setInterval(() => checkAndLoad({ force: false }), POLL_MS); })();
